title: Recording: Monkberry Moon Delight by Paul and Linda McCartney | 1971
content:
Studio B, Sound Recorders Studio, Los Angeles
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Eirik Wangberg

Paul and Linda McCartney finished recording the vocals for the Ram song ‘Monkberry Moon Delight’ on 29 March 1971.

They added two more vocal tracks. The first had backing vocals from Paul, beginning with the screamed title just before the three minute mark, and containing the ad-libbed vocals that followed. The second featured more backing vocals from Paul and Linda.
